_doc: FROZEN pre-registration, written BEFORE the P&L replay ran (episode POPULATION was necessarily extracted first to know what to fetch option bars for -- that is data collection, not an outcome peek; no dollar figure or exit reason was computed before this file was written). J-directed forensic Q2 (2026-07-23): Safe's 15:36 trendline bear signal today was SKIP_LATE_ENTRY'd (8 ENTER_BEAR verdicts 15:36-15:49, all past the entry_no_trade_after_et=15:00 ceiling). Upgrade of the 2026-07-21 chef study (strategy/candidates/2026-07-21-202600-late-entry-ceiling-reconsider.md, SPY-spot-direction-proxy method) to REAL per-episode option-economics P&L via exit_manager_walk -- the task's explicit instruction.

population.method: Exhaustive scan of automation/state/core-decisions.jsonl (full retained history, 2026-06-25..2026-07-23) + automation/state/fleet/*/decisions.jsonl (0 matches -- fleet arms did not fire a bear SKIP_LATE_ENTRY in this window) for action=='SKIP_LATE_ENTRY' AND side=='P' AND verdict=='ENTER_BEAR' (bear-only, per Q2's explicit scope -- Q1/today's incident was a bear trade). Consecutive same-account fires <=3 minutes apart collapsed into ONE episode (a single re-confirming signal is one trading opportunity, not N independent ones -- Rule 4), matching the 2026-07-21 chef study's own episode-grouping convention exactly.
population.note: Retention window is now ~4 weeks (core-decisions.jsonl spans 2026-06-25 onward), longer than the 07-21 study's disclosed ~2-week retention at that time -- more evidence has passively accumulated, per that study's own 'next_step' plan.

entry_reconstruction.entry_time: the FIRST block-fire minute of each episode (Rule 4 -- only the first re-confirmation of a repeating signal is a genuinely new trigger)
entry_reconstruction.entry_premium: the option contract's OWN 5-min OHLC bar OPEN at/after the first block-fire minute (same convention as engine_fullhist_replay.py / trail_width_exit_ab.py's real-fills entry proxy)
entry_reconstruction.strike_convention: ATM (round(SPY spot at block time)), consistent across ALL 21 episodes for both accounts -- a disclosed APPROXIMATION (the blocked entries never reached strike selection; CLAUDE.md's V15_SAFE_TIERS documents core Safe trades ATM, so this matches Safe's real convention exactly; applied uniformly to Bold episodes too for methodological consistency, disclosed as a deviation from Bold's live OTM-2 tier).
entry_reconstruction.qty_convention: 3 contracts (Rule 6 minimum-lot floor) uniformly -- the blocked entries never reached position sizing, disclosed approximation.
entry_reconstruction.trigger_level: trigger_level_exact from the live decision log where present (2/21 episodes); None otherwise -> falls back to stop_mode=='premium' (premium_stop_pct=-0.20) IDENTICALLY to how a real entry with no recoverable level would resolve -- never a fabricated level.

exit_method.engine: backtest/lib/exit_manager_walk.py#walk_exit_manager -- the REAL exit_manager.plan_exit_actions decision core, NOT a spot-price proxy (the upgrade this task asked for over the 07-21 study).
exit_method.exit_shape: automation/state/fleet/strategies.py#RIBBON_RIDE.exit.to_dict() -- the live shape, unmodified (this is a KEEP/MOVE/RETEST verdict on the CEILING, not an exit-shape A/B).
exit_method.ribbon_flip_back: modeled (continuous RTH ribbon lookup + backward merge_asof onto each contract's own bar timestamps, same construction as engine_fullhist_replay.py / catastrophe_stop_shakeout_ab.py).

verdict_rule.KEEP_if: n >= floor AND aggregate real-fills P&L across all 21 episodes is negative or flat (the ceiling is correctly avoiding a losing cohort)
verdict_rule.MOVE_TO_X_if: n >= floor AND aggregate P&L is clearly positive AND the loss is concentrated specifically in the currently-blocked 15:00-15:xx band (not the documented 15:45+ broker-rejection scar band, which stays hard-blocked regardless of P&L -- see band_B_scar_disposition in the 07-14 chef precedent, not re-litigated here)
verdict_rule.RETEST_INSUFFICIENT_N_if: n < floor, OR result is mixed-sign/sub-window-unstable in a way a 21-episode sample cannot resolve -- reported honestly, not forced either direction
verdict_rule.decisive_number: aggregate real-fills $ across all 21 episodes + per-account split + win rate, stated plainly in the .md verdict line.

reconciliation_with_2026_07_21_chef_stud: That study used a SPY-spot-direction proxy (favorable/unfavorable by 15:50 close) on 19 ALL-DIRECTION episodes and found 10-31% favorable hit rate depending on ceiling tested -- REJECTED loosening. This study restricts to the 21 BEAR-ONLY episodes (a slightly different, larger-by-2-weeks population) and replays REAL option P&L via exit_manager_walk instead of a spot proxy -- a methodologically stronger, independent check on the same underlying question. Both results reported; agreement or disagreement stated plainly.
